programme.desc: Atlanta Georgia is known as the underground Mecca of Comedy and a 'proving ground' for many black comedians. Comedy legends such as Steve Harvey, Monique, Cedric the Entertainer, Nipsey Russell, Raven Symone, Bruce Bruce, and Chris Tucker have called it home.
